content.name: p
children: Running pgroles as superuser works and satisfies every row in the table above automatically — there is nothing to grant, adopt, or troubleshoot. The cost is the one every DBA already weighs: the connection can do anything to the cluster, not just what pgroles' manifest describes. Scoped
privileges are the recommended default; superuser is a pragmatic fallback for small or throwaway environments.
